# One requirement per line; format: <source-L-doc>: <description>

L10: Flex Bus link training: negotiate CXL vs PCIe via the Alternate Protocol mechanism.
L10: CXL version negotiation: 1.1 / 2.0 / 3.0 common-capability selection.
L10: CXL.io enumeration: PCIe config space + CXL DVSEC discovery; device-type detection.
L10: CXL.cache D2H read (RdShared / RdOwn) + H2D snoop + GO/Data response.
L10: CXL.mem M2S MemRd → S2M DRS (MemData) + NDR (Cmp).
L10: CXL.mem M2S MemWr (RwD) → S2M NDR (Cmp).
L10: Type 1 device: CXL.io + CXL.cache only (no CXL.mem) behavior.
L10: Type 2 device: device-bias / host-bias mode (CXL 1.x) per 4 KB page.
L10: Type 2/3 device: Back-Invalidation (BI) on local-memory modification (CXL 3.0).
L10: Type 3 memory expander: HDM Decoder programming + host load/store.
L10: 256-byte Flit operation on the PCIe 6.0 PAM-4 PHY (CXL 3.0).
L10: 68-byte Flit operation on the PCIe 5.0 PHY (CXL 1.x/2.0).
L10: ARB/MUX fairness: interleave CXL.io and CXL.cache/CXL.mem Flits.
L10: Memory pooling: separate device-memory segment per host (CXL 2.0/3.0).
L10: Memory sharing: same segment across multiple devices (CXL 3.0).
L10: Multi-level switching + Port-Based-Routing fabric (CXL 3.0).
L10: Flit CRC error injection → link-layer retry (replay).
L10: Poison + viral propagation on uncorrectable error.
L10: Type 3 mailbox commands: identify, health info, event log, firmware.
L10: Backward compatibility: CXL 3.0 port trains with a CXL 1.1 / 2.0 partner.
L10: Fallback: CXL port trains as plain PCIe against a non-CXL partner.
L16: Runs over the PCIe Flex Bus; CXL vs PCIe selected via the PCIe Alternate Protocol negotiation.
L16: Three sub-protocols on one link: CXL.io (mandatory) + CXL.cache + CXL.mem (per device type).
L16: CXL.cache + CXL.mem share a common link/transaction layer, separate from CXL.io.
L16: ARB/MUX multiplexes the CXL.io stack against the CXL.cache/CXL.mem stack before the PCIe PHY.
L16: Asymmetric coherence: the host memory controller is the sole cache agent.
L16: Device types: Type 1 (io+cache), Type 2 (io+cache+mem), Type 3 (io+mem).
L16: CXL 3.0: 256-byte Flit on the PCIe 6.0 PAM-4 PHY at 64 GT/s.
L16: CXL 3.0 enhanced coherency: Back-Invalidation (BI) replaces 1.x bias modes.
L16: CXL 3.0: memory pooling + memory sharing; Port-Based Routing up to 4,096 nodes.
L16: Backward compatible with CXL 1.1/2.0 and with plain PCIe.
